target_text: Battleship Hiei, crippled off Savo after the night action of 12–13 November
source_locator: R2232: ch. 2, The Battle for Guadalcanal
notes: Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 2: seventeen B-17s from Espiritu Santo scored hits on Hiei on 13–14 November 1942. Entered on 13 November, the first day named for that attack, with target place Ironbottom Sound (named water, kind area, so the mission confidence is not capped at 0.5). Confidence 0.7: official AAF history. Base claim C13032 (6 August, Pekoa) is in force.
